description: This file defines a service class 'DefectService' that contains business logic for managing 'Defect' entities, including create, list, get, update, and delete operations, typical of CRUD functionality within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: DefectService
classes.description: Spring service component providing CRUD operations for Defect entities with transactional management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Defect from provided DTO and creator info, and saves it using DefectRepository.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all Defect entities.

methods.name: getOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a Defect by its ID or throws an EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Defect with data from the DTO and saves the changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Defect by its ID if it exists, or throws EntityNotFoundException.
